text:
Hannah Lee: Quick update / question — we got a foster placement notice and I need to start an intermittent leave ASAP (maybe partial days) while placement settles. Is there a fast-track for intake + emergency short-term care subsidy? Also need a minimal handoff for my 2 weekly customer calls.

people-ops-bot: Hi Hannah! Congrats. See foster & kinship guidance here: https://intranet.redwood/people/family-leave. We support Backup Care reimbursements and may approve emergency advances case-by-case. Please fill the parental intake form and mark "urgent placement".

Ravi Patel: @Hannah we have an emergency fallback process. If you tag the intake as "urgent placement" it escalates to Benefits for 48h review. Emergency Backup Care can be advanced up to $1,500 pending receipts. You'll need manager sign-off.

Benefits Team: To confirm: for foster placements we treat eligible short-term care the same as parental Backup Care. Submit intake + expected invoices. If you need funds before receipts, request an "advance" in the form and attach a brief note about expected providers.

Manager - Zoe: I can cover the customer calls for the first 2 weeks and take over approvals under $2k. @Hannah, please drop the key talking points and scheduled links and I'll run them. We can split your afternoons if you need partial coverage.

Hannah Lee: Thank you Zoe. For partial days — does Redwood support intermittent leave scheduling (e.g., mornings only + afternoons off) without exhausting full leave bank?

Legal: Good Q. Intermittent leave for foster placement is supported; it coordinates with local leave laws. We recommend documenting anticipated schedule in the intake so payroll and Benefits can set proper deductions. Also if any external agency requires a staff contact, add the contact to the intake.

Ravi Patel: Payroll note: if you're requesting an advance, finance will process as a non-taxable payroll advance contingent on receipts. We need receipts within 45 days or the advance may be reconciled.

Hannah Lee: Sounds good. Any special docs the agency needs from Redwood for placement?

Legal: Usually agencies ask for a placement verification letter. We can generate a standard verification within 2 business days after intake if you check the box on the form. We'll need your manager to confirm dates.

IT Helpdesk: If you want teammates to have temporary viewer access to any dashboards for demos, we can create 14-day viewer links and add them to the calendar invites.

Hannah Lee: I'll file the intake now and tick urgent + verification letter. Zoe, I'll paste the customer call slide deck and 3 bullet runbook in 30m. Thank you all so much.

Benefits Team: Once intake is in, expect a 48h response for urgent tags. If you need help filling the form, DM us and we can start it for you. :heart:
